captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 2.
In this lesson: What's the weather like? Talk about the weather and use ‘It is…’.
Here are some new words. Sunny. The sun is shining. Rainy.
Water falls from the clouds. Windy. The air is moving fast. Listen and say them. sunny
rainy
windy.
And some more words. Cloudy. There are lots of clouds. Hot. Very warm. Cold.
Not warm at all. Listen and say them. cloudy
hot
cold.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: the sun is shining?
Now some grammar: It is and It isn't.
We talk about the weather with ‘It is’ (It's) and ‘It isn't’.
For example: It is sunny today. For example: It isn't cold.
Now listen, and read along. The weather this week. On Monday it is sunny and hot.
We go to the beach. On Tuesday it is rainy. We play inside. On Wednesday it is windy.
We fly a kite in the park. On Thursday it is cloudy and cold. We wear our coats.
Another question. The video will stop. What is the weather like on Monday?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like sunny, rainy, windy.
You practised it is and it isn't. And you read The weather this week.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!

sections.title: What are you wearing?

q.prompt: Which word means “a warm thing you wear outside”?
q.reason: “coat” means a warm thing you wear outside.

options.fb: “boots” means strong shoes for rain or snow.
“hat” means you wear it on your head.

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 2. In this lesson: What are you wearing?
Name clothes and say what people are wearing now.
Here are some new words. Coat. A warm thing you wear outside. Hat.
You wear it on your head. Boots. Strong shoes for rain or snow. Listen and say them.
coat
hat
boots.
And some more words. Scarf. You wear it round your neck. Dress.
A girl's or woman's clothes in one piece. Shorts. Short trousers for hot days.
Listen and say them. scarf
dress
shorts.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: a warm thing you wear outside?
Now some grammar: I am wearing (present continuous).
Use am / is / are + a verb with -ing for things happening now.
For example: I am wearing a hat. For example: She is wearing boots.
Now listen, and read along. A postcard from the mountains.
Dear Grandpa, We are in the mountains. It is snowing!
I am wearing my blue coat, my boots and a hat. Dad is wearing a big scarf.
Mum is making a snowman. See you soon! Love, Zara
Another question. The video will stop. Who is the postcard to?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like coat, hat, boots.
You practised I am wearing (present continuous).
And you read A postcard from the mountains. Now try the practice questions.
See you next time!
